exposure: Quality improvement intervention to reduce early elective deliveries
cohort: This study used vital records data from 2007 to 2013 for all singleton births occurring at or after 36 weeks in 66 Tennessee hospitals, grouped into three QI cohorts.
finding: A statewide QI intervention to reduce early elective deliveries (EEDs) was associated with modest but significant declines in EEDs beyond concurrent and national trends, and showed mixed results in related infant and maternal outcomes.
